errors.evidence: The description states the metric is "prediction speed, in units of seconds". However, the y-axis is labeled "句对数 / s" (sentence pairs / s), which is a unit of throughput/speed, not time. Throughout the text, the unit is incorrectly given as "秒" (seconds) and the metric as "预测耗时" (prediction time).
The description identifies the last category on the x-axis as "16-20", but the label in the figure is clearly "15-16".
The description states the y-axis range is from 0 to 3000. While the labeled major ticks go up to 3000, the axis itself extends to above 3500 to accommodate the data point 3516.
The description claims there is no specific sorting method. However, the categories on the x-axis are sorted in ascending order of sentence length (1-5, 6-10, 11-15, 15-16).
